thesis: Observational agreement does not establish intervention-preserving equivalence.
role: Adds causality and active experimental separation.

ideas.statement: Causal abstraction requires corresponding interventions as well as state maps, so intervening and abstracting agree.
Compression for passive prediction can discard distinctions required for control.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Two lights share observations under either direct copying or a common hidden switch, but forcing one off separates the mechanisms.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Sequential prediction can represent interventions given identifying data; current models may all share a false assumption.
